# TPC-DS-OBT Q5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ssr AS (SELECT obt.store_s_store_id, SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt CROSS JOIN (SELECT obt.store_sk AS store_sk, obt.sold_date_sk AS date_sk, obt.ext_sales_price AS sales_price, obt.net_profit AS profit, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS return_amt, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS net_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE channel = 'store' UNION ALL SELECT obt.store_sk AS store_sk, obt.returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS sales_price, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS profit, obt.return_amount AS return_amt, obt.return_net_loss AS net_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE channel = 'store') AS salesreturns WHERE (date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '14 DAY') AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk) AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web') GROUP BY obt.store_s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT obt.catalog_page_cp_catalog_page_id, SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt CROSS JOIN (SELECT obt.catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, obt.sold_date_sk AS date_sk, obt.ext_sales_price AS sales_price, obt.net_profit AS profit, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS return_amt, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS net_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE channel = 'catalog' UNION ALL SELECT obt.catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, obt.returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS sales_price, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS profit, obt.return_amount AS return_amt, obt.return_net_loss AS net_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE channel = 'catalog') AS salesreturns WHERE (date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '14 DAY') AND page_sk = obt.catalog_page_cp_catalog_page_sk) AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web') GROUP BY obt.catalog_page_cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT obt.web_site_web_site_id, SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt CROSS JOIN (SELECT obt.web_site_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, obt.sold_date_sk AS date_sk, obt.ext_sales_price AS sales_price, obt.net_profit AS profit, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS return_amt, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS net_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE channel = 'web' UNION ALL SELECT obt.web_site_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, obt.returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS sales_price, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS profit, obt.return_amount AS return_amt, obt.return_net_loss AS net_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk AND obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id) AND channel = 'web') AS salesreturns WHERE (date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '14 DAY') AND wsr_web_site_sk = obt.web_site_web_site_sk) AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web') GROUP BY obt.web_site_web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_s_store_id AS id, sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_cp_catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100
```
